wc:minerva-quadrant-chart.summary: Four-quadrant matrix of labelled, draggable dots.
wc:minerva-quadrant-chart.description: Four-quadrant matrix (priority matrix, Eisenhower, BCG...) of `minerva-design/charts/core` (the `<QuadrantChart>` of React): tinted quadrants with titles, dividers and labelled dots placed without overlapping labels. With `drag-points`, dots can be dragged to another quadrant (`minerva-point-drop`; update `points` to move them). A visually hidden list of the dots per quadrant lets screen readers and keyboards reach every dot: arrows move between them, Enter clicks (`minerva-point-click`) and, with `drag-points`, Shift + arrows move the focused dot to the neighbouring quadrant (`minerva-point-drop`, announced in a live region). The focused dot is drawn with a focus ring and reported by `minerva-hover`. One glass point card names the hovered, keyboard-focused or dragged dot (its name and quadrant) in place of the engine tooltip; with slotted `point-actions`, the card also shows them and stays on the `selected-index` dot (read the dot they act on from `activeIndex`). Slotted content is placed over the plot: a header per quadrant (in its outer corner, replacing the drawn title, badge, description and count) and the actions in the point card. Both receive pointer events; the rest of the plot stays interactive. Published as the optional entry `minerva-design/web-components/chart`.
